title: A lesson (lessons/<id>/lesson.yaml)
description: What of the toolkit a lesson teaches: its techniques, and the steps of its journey. The toolkit (under-test) holds each technique's rules, in techniques/<id>/technique.yaml, and each journey step's instructions, in .github/skills/<name>/SKILL.md; this repo says which lessons teach each one, and its checks keep the catalogue, the lessons index and every link into the toolkit in step with these files. A lesson with an example names at least one technique or skill. Words follow GLOSSARY.md.

id.description: The lesson's folder name, under lessons/.

title.description: The lesson's name, as its README and the lessons index give it.

techniques.description: Ids of the toolkit techniques this lesson teaches: folder names under the toolkit's techniques/. May be empty where the lesson teaches a journey step instead (skills).

skills.description: Names of the skills of the toolkit journey steps this lesson teaches: folder names under the toolkit's .github/skills/ (docs/decisions/0033).
